ios.desc:
Alternate reader for Hackernews with some AI features using LLM's such as similarity search.
Other features:  
find similar comments, similar stories, and similar users. 
Find users and comments using similarity search on input text using positive and negative queries.  
sort comments by user karma.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Similar user search for Hacker News

We implemented member similarity in our hacker read app: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/hacker-read/id6479697844

Once you register on ios, you can also login through webapp: 
https://hn.garglet.com

probably not ready for a hacker news hug of death yet, but you can try.
quotes.story_title: Show HN: Exploring HN by mapping and analyzing 40M posts and comments for fun

quotes.text:
features:

1. find similar users

2. similarity and dissimilarity  search for comments

3. Browse user comments from oldest first

4. Flattened comments in reverse chronological order on stories

5. Find similar stories

Self hosted on a single machine. Probably not ready, but oh well…

Instructions for free trial:

(create account -> confirm email -> request free trial from profile page).

Or download ios app: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/hacker-read/id6479697844
